live: authority revoked if >= 60 live forward labels exist and live mse_skill <= 0 or accepted mean <= 0
model_choice: higher MSE skill (1-mse/const_mse) on 2023-09..2024-08 OOS; if both <=0 -> no authority
target: next 6h (6x1h) close-to-close return minus 0.14% round-trip cost
walk_forward: refit every 720 bars (30d) on labels ending before the prediction bar (purged), 2y window; day-based feature windows scaled to 1h bars
